name: Frame Window Mod
description: Measures the frame window of every input of a GDR replay with the real game physics, and computes NaNDL precision (L*).

presses.name: Measure presses
presses.description: Measure the frame window of every press (click).

releases.name: Measure releases
releases.description: Also measure releases. Slower; windows of releases are usually not counted by NaNDL-style precision.

keep-hold.name: Keep hold length
keep-hold.description: When a press is moved, move its release by the same amount (measures the whole click). Off: only the single input is moved.

full-completion.name: Validate to completion
full-completion.description: Each candidate must complete the whole level. Exact but slower. Off: the candidate must survive the validation horizon.

horizon.name: Validation horizon (s)
horizon.description: Seconds the run must survive after the moved input (ignored when validating to completion). Longer is safer for inputs whose mistakes show up late.

max-window.name: Max window
max-window.description: Stop searching once the window is known to exceed this many ticks (the value is then shown as 'N+'). Larger = more exact, slower.

repeats.name: Repeats per candidate
repeats.description: Run every candidate this many times; inputs where results disagree are marked unstable (random triggers etc.).

from-input.name: From input #
from-input.description: First input number to analyze (1 = first).

to-input.name: To input #
to-input.description: Last input number to analyze (0 = until the end).

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: How fast the simulation runs. Max uses about 12 ms of every frame.

mute.name: Mute during analysis
mute.description: Silence music and effects while the analysis runs (every trial restarts the level).

input-phase.name: Input phase
input-phase.description: When inputs are applied inside a physics step. Auto picks 'After commands' for Mega Hack replays. Change it if Verify fails on a replay that is known to be good.

p-respawn.name: Precision: respawn (s)
p-respawn.description: Time between a death and the next attempt, added to every input time.

p-target.name: Precision: target time (s)
p-target.description: Expected time to complete the level that L* is solved for (86400 = 24 hours).

p-kt.name: Precision: Nerve k_T
p-kt.description: Time-dependent nerve constant (default calibrated by NaN GD / Frame Window Counter).

p-releases.name: Precision: include releases
p-releases.description: Use release windows as inputs in the L* model too.
